color_prompts.bench:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a portrait A4 industrial design pencil sketch plate for a university diploma, printable at high native resolution (prefer 2304 x 3264 pixels or similar A4 aspect ratio). Genuine hand-drawn graphite construction lines, visible pencil hatching and subtle colored-pencil material shading on clean white sketchbook paper, no glossy CGI, no CAD diagram, no vector art, no markers, no photograph of a sketchbook, no physical pens in frame. Restrained, minimal, sophisticated furniture styling. Original design, no logos, no brand names. Material language inspired by the supplied BORK photos: warm dark walnut grain, quiet cognac/stone upholstery, small brushed-metal junctions, matte charcoal structural steel. Use the supplied author's collage ONLY for pencil drawing language, not for its subjects. No text, lettering, signatures, numerals or dimension strings anywhere; explanatory labels will be typeset later. Maintain ample white space between drawings, no objects cut off. These are early concept studies, do not imply engineering certification. Maintain clear believable connections and load paths; fixed support rails are connected to the floor-standing frame, never a cable, hinge or magnetic accessory. No screens, no springs, no wall drilling.
Subject: ONE consistent floor-standing storage bench family. Top 55%: large beautiful 3/4 hero perspective of a low rounded-rectangular walnut storage bench with a thin removable stone/cognac seat pad, two separately accessible front storage drawers, and an independent side slot for a thin folding floor mat. A rigid U-shaped fixed hand support rises at the LEFT short end to standing hand height, made of a modest continuous charcoal steel frame with a comfortable walnut grip sleeve; it remains the same in all views. Frame connects under the seat to two broad low floor skids at the short ends, with NO crossbar across the front walking approach. The body does not float. Middle 25%: smaller reverse perspective with one drawer pulled out showing a pair of dumbbells secured in individual padded recesses; separate folded mat beside the slot. Bottom 20%: two small gestural human-use vignettes, an older adult standing beside and holding that fixed rail with one hand, and a child on all fours on the separate mat with an opposite arm and leg extended. The child is far from weights; all heavy drawers are closed in this vignette. People are simple natural pencil sketches, not portraits. Keep the rail visibly rigid, not an adjustable gym attachment. Distinct open space in front for sit-to-stand. No backrest adjustment, no wheels.

Subject: ONE consistent tall compact walnut floor-standing cabinet workout station, comparative early concept. TOP HALF two equally clear 3/4 views side by side: LEFT storage state, RIGHT exercise state. Stable wide U-shaped dark steel floor footprint in BOTH views, extends forward beyond cabinet, open across its front so the user approaches without stepping over a horizontal crossbar. Cabinet is independent of the wall, no wall mount. Closed view has a slim warm walnut cabinet, rounded edges, elegant two-zone storage, a vertical folded seat panel flush in front, and a fixed rectangular hand support frame continuously linked to floor chassis outside front corners. Open view shows the same seat panel unfolded horizontally at ordinary chair height; TWO real front supporting legs reach the ground, each connected under the seat. Main fixed hand support remains linked to stationary frame, not the hinged seat. Walnut and warm gray upholstery, charcoal frame, discrete warm brushed hardware. MIDDLE: close-up study of a clearly engaged mechanical seat/leg lock and a separate removable light storage tray. BOTTOM: a small seated older adult with both feet on floor and clear knee space using the opened station; also a simple top-view footprint study showing open approach between two skids and room ahead of the seat. Preserve practical proportions, do not put the person inside the cabinet. Frame and support remain present even when storage is empty.

cabinet_correction_prompt: Edit the supplied pencil sketch plate while preserving the same warm colored-pencil style, walnut/stone/charcoal palette, white paper, six-vignette composition and the original cabinet family. Correct a functional error. In ALL views REMOVE THE ENTIRE HORIZONTAL SUPPORT RAIL CROSSING THE FRONT OF THE SEAT. Front approach, knees and sit-to-stand path must be completely open. Replace it with TWO SHORT FIXED SIDE HANDRAILS, one along each side of seat, like the arm supports of a stable chair but mechanically linked to the stationary steel side frame and floor chassis, NOT linked to the hinged seat. Side rails end at front corner posts; no bar connects left to right in front. Keep TWO distinct seat support legs down to floor when open, rigid large U-shaped footprint open at front, no wall fixing. In the seated-human vignette show an elderly adult with feet flat on floor, hands on left and right SIDE rails, legs free in front, correct natural anatomy, no bar or rail across lap or chest. In top-view vignette the open approach is visibly clear. Preserve folding seat in closed and open views. Simplify the upper storage: only two compact dumbbells in separate cradles, a SOFT fabric ball and a folded thin mat; NO kettlebells, no rigid yoga blocks. In the detail vignette at middle right replace jump rope and wooden ring with the same soft fabric ball and light fabric target in a small removable walnut tray. Upper storage doors may be closed in the closed view to suggest controlled access to heavy objects. Hardware close-up stays an illustrative mechanical lock. No lettering, logos, numbers or dimensions. Portrait A4 aspect, high resolution. This is a provisional industrial design study, not a verified construction.
monochrome_prompt: Transform ONLY the drawing medium of the supplied completed portrait industrial design sketch plate into pure black-and-white graphite pencil drawing on clean white paper. Preserve the same objects, product geometry, all viewpoints, people, poses, frame members, storage layout, open/closed states, small details and exact page composition. Replace colored-pencil walnut and fabric hues with differentiated graphite hatching and gray tonal values, keep convincing wood grain and material separation. No warm paper tint, sepia, brown, blue or other color; every pixel should be neutral gray. Keep lively faint construction lines and controlled pencil shading; no ink wash, no vector tracing, no new objects, no logos, no text or numbers. Preserve original portrait A4 proportions. Re-render at the highest available native resolution. This is a matching monochrome presentation variant of an early concept, not a new design.
